testimonials-list.name: Mara Ellison
testimonials-list.role: Interior Designer and Cat Mum, London
testimonials-list.text: I've tried so many pet beds that looked terrible in my flat. The Linen Cloud Bed from Pet360 is genuinely beautiful — my cat loves it and it actually complements my décor. First time I've ever felt good about a pet purchase.

testimonials-list.name: James Okafor
testimonials-list.text: The Elevated Ceramic Feeder Set is worth every penny. My dogs eat slower, the bowls are easy to clean, and it doesn't look like a pet shop exploded in my kitchen. Ordered a second set for my parents.

testimonials-list.name: Sofia Reyes
testimonials-list.text: As a vet nurse I'm picky about materials. Pet360's Bamboo Slow Feeder Bowl is one of the few I'd actually recommend — non-toxic, well-made, and it genuinely helps dogs with bloat risk. My patients' owners love it.

testimonials-list.name: Tom and Priya Whitfield
testimonials-list.text: We bought the Rattan Hideaway Cat House expecting our cat to ignore it. She moved in within 20 minutes and hasn't left. It looks incredible in our living room. Pet360 is the only place we shop for her now.

about.heading: Built by Pet Lovers, for Pet Lovers
about.heroBody: We started Pet360 because we believed that loving your pet and loving your home shouldn't be a compromise. Five years on, we're proud to have helped over 12,000 pet owners create spaces they're genuinely proud of.
about.storyHeading: From a Spare Room to a Beloved Brand
about.storyBody1: Pet360 was founded in 2019 by Emma Clarke, a product designer and lifelong dog owner who was tired of choosing between products that were good for her dog and products that looked good in her home. She started designing her own in a spare room in East London.
about.storyBody2: What began as a small Etsy shop quickly grew into a full brand. Today, Pet360 works with artisan manufacturers across the UK and Europe, and every product is still tested by real pets before it reaches our shelves.

values.title: Sustainability First
values.body: We use natural, recycled, and responsibly sourced materials across our entire range. No virgin plastics, no greenwashing.

values.title: Designed with Love
values.body: Every product is designed in-house by our team of designers and tested by real pets before it goes on sale.

values.title: Quality Over Quantity
values.body: We'd rather make 60 products we're proud of than 600 we're not. Every item earns its place in our range.

values.title: Community Driven
values.body: Our customers shape what we make. We listen to feedback, run beta tests, and co-design new products with our community.

team.name: Emma Clarke

team.name: Jess Thornton
